title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

**Job Title: Lead Frontend Engineer (React.js)
  
  
Experience Required: 10+ Years
  
  
Location: Nashik / Pune, India**
**## About the Role**
RIB Software is looking for a hands-on Lead Frontend Engineer to shape the architecture and delivery of our cloud-based SaaS applications for construction collaboration. You will set technical direction, make clear trade-offs, support teams through implementation, and remain close to the code.
  
  
**## Who You Will Work With**
You will join the Collaboration Team, an in-house design and engineering group connecting office and construction-site workflows through focused digital tools. You will work closely with product, UX, backend, QA, DevOps, platform teams, and engineering leadership across a geographically distributed organization.
  
  
**## What You Will Do**

* Lead the architecture, design, development, testing, and delivery of performant, accessible, and maintainable frontend applications.
* Define clear frontend boundaries, integration contracts, reusable patterns, golden paths, and scalable delivery standards, including micro-frontends, shared platform capabilities, APIs, backend-for-frontend patterns, versioning, and compatibility.
* Document significant decisions, review frontend ADRs, evaluate trade-offs, and challenge short-term solutions that create unnecessary long-term risk.
* Drive engineering quality through automated testing, code review, performance, accessibility, observability, secure coding, and production readiness.
* Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve analysis, prototyping, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation, with proper validation and human review.
* Translate product and design intent into technically sound, design-system-aligned solutions without creating unnecessary central dependencies or blocking product teams.
* Mentor engineers, raise the quality of technical discussions, and help teams move from broad requirements to clear, deliverable solutions.
* Support existing applications, lead incremental modernization, and define practical migration and deprecation paths where needed.

**## What You Bring**

* \*\*React and TypeScript: \*\* 6+ years of hands-on experience building and operating production web applications with React and TypeScript.
* \*\*Architecture: \*\* Proven experience designing and evolving frontend architecture, defining boundaries, assessing trade-offs, and guiding implementation across teams.
* \*\*Technical leadership: \*\* Demonstrated ability to define standards, review technical decisions, mentor engineers, and influence teams without relying only on formal authority.
* \*\*Modern web engineering: \*\* Strong understanding of component architecture, state and data management, API integration, performance, accessibility, testing, and maintainability.
* \*\*System thinking: \*\* Experience balancing team autonomy, shared platform needs, delivery speed, technical debt, and long-term maintainability.
* \*\*AI-enabled development: \*\* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering outcomes rather than replace engineering judgement.
* \*\*Communication and ownership: \*\* Strong written and verbal communication, clear ownership, and the ability to turn ambiguity into concrete decisions and actions.
* \*\*Delivery discipline: \*\* Experience with Git/GitHub, CI/CD, cloud environments, Jira, Confluence, and modern engineering workflows.
* Formal education is not required. \*\* We value demonstrated experience, technical judgement, continuous learning, and evidence of impact over academic credentials.

**## Nice to Have**

* Experience with micro-frontends, domain-driven design, backend-for-frontend patterns, or multi-team SaaS platforms.
* Experience with design systems, Figma-to-code workflows, component libraries, cross-product frontend governance, or user-facing AI capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with Testing Library, Jest, Playwright, Cypress, or comparable frontend testing tools.
* Experience with observability, production support, secure development, and frontend platform modernization.

**## What Success Looks Like**

* Teams have clear standards, documented decisions, reusable patterns, and practical guidance they can apply independently.
* Frontend boundaries and integration contracts support team autonomy without weakening platform consistency.
* Technical risks, exceptions, migrations, and deprecations are visible, justified, and actively managed.
* AI-assisted development improves delivery and quality without weakening review, testing, security, or maintainability.
* Applications are fast, accessible, reliable, and secure, while engineers make better decisions through effective mentorship and technical leadership.

**## Our Culture**
At RIB Software, we value customer orientation, innovation, excellence, secure engineering, and responsible decision-making. We are looking for someone who leads by example, asks the right questions, and helps teams choose the right solution for immediate delivery and the long-term platform.
  
  
RIB may require all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
RIB is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect.
